title.narrative: Community Sensitisation on Ebola outbreak in Three Chiefdoms in the Bombali District

description.narrative: Accountability Alert Sierra Leone is a CAFOD implementing partner operating in Bombali District, Northern Sierra Lone, working with rural communities to improve women’s access to land. Since the outbreak of Ebola in Sierra Leone several organisations have been engaged on sensitization and awareness raising campaign on the prevention and control of the spread of Ebola in various communities. Unfortunately, message dissemination is through radio or television and communities where AASL operations are far in the interior of the Northern province of the country and cannot access TV signals and even where they are broadcast over the Radio, most if not all, are extremely poor to access radio sets to listen to these messages. Therefore, AASL with funding from CAFOD is targeting these communities, where traditional burial, mistrust and denial of Ebola is pervasive. The project strategy is to train chiefdom authorities (20 women and 10 men), 60 women leaders and 45 men leaders and, youth (25 females and 20 males) and 18 traditional healers (10 females and 8 males) on EVD transmission and prevention measures, carry out Focus Group Discussions with Chiefdom authorities, (women, men and youths) to assess the level of knowledge of the community about the disease and consequently help shape the sensitization messages and content of trainings.
